comment: Lives at the repository root so the Vercel Git integration builds the frontend without a Root Directory override. API_BASE_URL, COGNITO_DOMAIN and COGNITO_CLIENT_ID come from the project environment variables; no secret is ever emitted into the bundle.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' https://*.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com https://*.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com; form-action https://*.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'none'
